answer: Agents can resist Sybil identities by requiring each new vertex to post a refundable stake before it can trade, then weighting its signal by observed behavior and slashing the stake when linked accounts fabricate demand, collude, or default. A fake identity campaign must lock up capital for every account, while coordinated abuse risks losing all of it. Honest agents recover their stake, whereas a durable onyx reputation becomes costly to counterfeit.
